top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock is an original invention (Katori's magic-wavelength trapping, realized and pushed to the 1e-18 regime by Ye) that is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes, has been reproduced and compared by independent laboratories, and has a clean two-person allocation that every proposing member shares. The citation should name the lattice clock and its magic-wavelength realization without claiming applications. I prefer awarding it to no award, though I still want the committee to state explicitly that it is an invention in the statutory sense and not only a record in precision.
recusal_note: I am a Fellow of the University of Tokyo since 2025 with exchanges there for over ten years, and Katori is based at Tokyo and RIKEN; this is an institutional connection only, with no collaboration, funding or personal tie to Katori or Ye, so it could be raised for recusal but I completed the ballot.
